message.content:
All three candidate submissions are used, so no further revisions are possible. Here is the account of the development pilot.

**Baseline → revisions (all on task `oscillator1`, training scope only)**

- `symbolic-000` (baseline): a plain linear model `p0*x + p1*v`, MSE 0.004363, NMSE 1.0 — a fit no better than predicting the target mean.
- `symbolic-001` (parent `symbolic-000`): added a quadratic `x^2` term (3 params). NMSE fell 1.0 → 0.09694 (predicted decrease of ≥0.3: **supported**). The declared binned-residual claims about the baseline were also supported. This was the single large gain.
- `symbolic-002` (parent `symbolic-001`): this candidate did not change the equation family meaningfully and returned NMSE 0.09639 (delta 0.00055, versus the declared ≥0.005 decrease: **prediction contradicted** — the actual gain was ten times smaller than declared). Both of its claims were `schema_invalid` (missing required binding fields, notably `session_id`), so no claim evidence was obtained from it. Its source_sha256 differs from 001, so some change was made, but it is not described in the retained state.
- `symbolic-003` (parent `symbolic-002`, current incumbent): replaced the quadratic with a cubic `p0*x + p1*v + p2*x^3`, 3 params. NMSE 0.09506, delta 0.00134 (predicted ≥0.0005 decrease: **supported**). Both claims supported: all x-bin mean residuals below 0.003 (largest 0.00275) and `abs_bias` ≈ 0.00187 below 0.005. Its source is also the only one carried in the packet as readable incumbent text, so I cannot re-inspect 001/002 directly.

**Observed signals in the final diagnostics (train only)**

- Residuals are now near-unbiased: bias ≈ 0.0019, `bias_squared_over_mse` ≈ 0.0084, so only ~0.8% of MSE is mean-offset.
- Variance of residual grows with |x|: x-bin RMSE rises from 0.0166 (most negative x bin) to 0.0232 (most positive x bin); the largest v-bin RMSE is 0.0304 for the *highest-velocity* bin. That is consistent with the target having a component not captured by the 3-parameter form, but the binned means show no monotone curvature, which is why the cubic only bought ~0.0013 NMSE.

**Failures and unresolved uncertainty**

- The `symbolic-002` prediction was an over-estimate by roughly 10×; after the first big win I over-predicted how much headroom remained in the nonlinear-in-x direction.
- `schema_invalid` on 002 shows the binding fields must be copied verbatim including `session_id`; I have not re-verified a claim since.
- Remaining uncertainty: whether the higher RMSE at large |v| reflects amplitude-dependent restoring force (suggesting richer x-structure, e.g. a higher odd polynomial, or a velocity-nonlinear term) or simply heteroscedastic/noise in the target. Nothing here establishes that, and all numbers are in-sample training fits — there is no held-out evaluation in this pilot, so I make no claim about generalization or about recovering the true equation.
- Submissions are exhausted; I did not get to test the amplitude-dependent hypothesis.

No new method or strategy is claimed — this was ordinary iteration on a fixed revision policy.
